svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-aviator-shirt-male-long-epaulet-sleeve-officer","name":"Men's Aviator Shirt Uniform adult officer epaulet sleeves (overlay, registered to garment-aviator-shirt-male-long; blank grade)","size_in":{"w":26.0508,"h":31.5847},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2605.08,3158.47],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"The slide-on epaulet sleeve as it lies on the shirt's strap: the strap polygon itself (0.9 in wide, one axis from the armhole seam to the collar end) cut square across 0.5 in + the button + 0.06 in short of the strap's point so the button shows; same outer end, same two long edges, upper edge the shoulder line, so it covers the strap and nothing else (Fig 4.16: the gray sleeve is as wide as the strap, 0.88-0.94 in at the pocket's 5.25 in). The top-down view is the separate asset garment-aviator-epaulet-top-*. Colours are those of the top-down sleeve assets (rank-epaulet-sleeve-gray-* #5f5c5c, measured on CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-1; cadet officers the family grade-cloth blue #142347, assets/epaulet-sleeve-colours.js), as the Class B sleeves, so the strip on the shirt and the view from above show one sleeve; the regulation gives no shade or dimension.","anchors":{"top_center":[1302.54,0],"bottom_center":[1302.54,3158.47],"center":[1302.54,1579.24],"left_edge":[0,1579.24],"right_edge":[2605.08,1579.24],"rank_slot_right_center":[577.83,340.1],"rank_slot_left_center":[2027.25,340.1],"rank_rule_point_right":[389.02,412.25],"rank_rule_point_left":[2216.06,412.25]},"landmarks":{"epaulet_sleeve_right":{"x":321.26,"y":205.6,"w":513.13,"h":273.54},"rank_slot_right":{"x":321.26,"y":205.6,"w":513.13,"h":273.54},"epaulet_sleeve_poly_right":[[321.26,389.96],[383.76,358.22],[802.05,205.6],[834.4,290.24],[340.01,479.15]],"epaulet_sleeve_left":{"x":1770.68,"y":205.6,"w":513.13,"h":273.54},"rank_slot_left":{"x":1770.68,"y":205.6,"w":513.13,"h":273.54},"epaulet_sleeve_poly_left":[[2283.81,389.96],[2221.31,358.22],[1803.01,205.6],[1770.68,290.24],[2265.07,479.15]]},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)","overlay_of":"garment-aviator-shirt-male-long","documented":["gray epaulet sleeves, embroidered grade (CAPR 39-1 4.2.5.1.1.1 / 4.2.6.2.1)","grade insignia centred 5/8 in from the outer end of the epaulet (DAFI 36-2903 4.5.1.1.1)"],"assumed":["sleeve length (ends short of the strap button)","grade not drawn: placed by the rank insignia assets at rank_slot (centre of the sleeve, on the strap axis)"],"fit":{"method":"original","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
